reviews.comment: Amazing professor and knowledgeable at what he does. I took the summer minimester so there was a lot of lectures to watch everyday which is what the tests are focused on but the videos were pretty engaging so it didn't feel like a drag. Super kind and cool professional, fair course despite minimester pacing, you're in good hands

Unfortunately took this class as an easy A, but I had to drop it  unfortunately because didn't too well on the first exam and I have a rigorous schedule already. Professor is very knowledgeable and provides interesting lectures, id you take notes using the slides you'll do alright

One of the best classes I've taken so far, Dr. Stewart has been my favorite professor so far. His grading criteria is clear, and his class isn't too difficult. Materials are easy to access, and the exam reviews COME IN CLUTCH. Before each exam, prioritize studying everything thats on the exam review, especially the sites. Overall a great class!

Took his online class, so even though it was kind of a lot of work you can get through it. Every week you're assigned a textbook reading, comprehension questions, and like two/three hours of videos. It's a pretty interesting class; I started slacking towards the end of the semester but it didn't really matter cause it's still an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is a good elective class. The homework assignments are fairly easy. The tests are more difficult, make sure you down load the exam guides.

I had Stewart for a class called the Gothic Cathedral and I absolutely loved the class. He has very interesting lectures and keeps you engaged through open discussion. He is very approachable and willing to help. He inspired me to take a look at professing myself.

Took Prof. Stewart for a minimester. Was clear about expectations and procedures regarding the class. Most of the class is memorization. To get a good grade make a spreadsheet and an outline of the specific locations and mentally tie the name to an image.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor. Gives interesting lectures and is passionate about subject matter!
I took the minimester course, it was a lot of work but the grading was more than fair, all you had to do was take care of business and pay attention, this course was worth it for sure
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took this class as creative arts elective. Prof Stewart was very helpful and really cared about us learning something new. 3 tests through semester accounted for 65% of overall grade. PREPARE for the time-crunched readings quizzes (at least online class delivery) and be willing to spend 7hrs prepping for exams. I'd take Stewart again for sure

I took this because I thought it would be a blow off class, but it's a lot of work! Long lectures every other day, but he really knows what he's talking about and I actually ended up really enjoying the content. Very responsive to emails and knows what he's doing.

He has extensive knowledge in architectural history. The homework online wasn't difficult, but it still helped the learning process. The in-class assignments and class discussions have set dates that are established in the syllabus so you know when not to skip, but exams are very lecture based. He truly wants you to learn and has effective methods.

Professor Stewart truly cares about his students. 3 Exams throughout the semester (including the final) that are based pretty much on memorization, he also gives pretty detailed exam reviews. Very accessible outside of class. He works to make sure that lectures are interesting and engaging. Overall a really nice guy that wants you to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Stewart really cares about his students and the material, but you definitely have to work for this class. If it's for an elective, I would take another one, unless you're genuinely interested in it. I studied more for this than Chem 101 and hardly skimmed by with an A... But he is a really nice guy and really wants you to succeed!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great prof. He really knows architecture and is enthusiastic about it. There are 3 exams worth 80% of your grade, so take notes and study hard. The rest is 10% for reading quizzes on the online textbook and 10% for in-class writing assignments. If you want an A, take notes during lecture so you dont screw up on your first exam like I did.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for my Creative Arts credit as I wasn't impressed by other creative arts classes. His lectures are picture-based and very few words (usually a place, location, and year). Take notes during class and the textbook is online($85) you need it for reading assignments(1-hour max) worth 10% of total grade. Study hard for the test.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I LOVE Dr. Stewart. He is funny, passionate, and one of those professors that makes you care about the subject. As a BIMS major in an architecture class, I was happy to have a break from science. The tests are 100% lecture based (don't buy textbook), and the only thing hard about this class is all the memorization.

Dr. Stewart is excellent at lecturing and teaching the material. However, taking this class as a creative art credit I would not recommend this class. The test were quite difficult and all there was to study for it was the notes taken from his lectures. I would recommend finding an easier class for a creative art credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not too hard, not too easy, somewhat intense...

Pretty easy class, you just need to show up most of the time and youre basically set. Lots of give-me grade boosters for attendance, homework takes very little time, and the exams are all multiple-choice. The study guides he gives you for the exams tell you everything that is necessary for a high grade, so just use Flashcards. Great lecturer.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is very enthusiastic and reasonable as well as available in office hours out of class.

He's a pretty good professor. The exams are very in depth and you have to study A LOT in order to do well. The homework is super easy and takes an hour max per week. There are 10 short writing assignments due in class. He is available to go over your review for the exams as well as go over what you missed on the previous exams.

He is such a great professor and truly loves what he is lecturing. He is so not the professor that just reads off his slides. He engages the students and it's like he's telling the stories of the world. He makes you work for your grade because he wants you to learn. Don't miss class because you're just setting yourself up to have gaps in knowledge.
He was an amazing teacher. He is very passionate about the subject and helped to convey the points. The class inst hard if you put a little bit of time and effort into it.

I really enjoyed this class. Stewart is a very knowledgeable prof and can teach the subject well. Homework takes max 45 min a week and is super easy. 10 in class writing assignments are basically attendance and help your grade quite a bit. Test are not easy, but manageable. Make a quizlet to study. Pay attention in class and take okayish notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was his first year teaching at A&M. Young guy with lots of knowledge. Inspiring but overwhelming at time. Only two tests and a final. Online homework quizzes once a week over the readings- basically completion. Provides study guides for tests and the final which helps. Majority of testing is memorization of locations, years, vocab, etc.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Took this class for an easy A but this prof makes it way harder than it needs to be. He only had 2 tests and the final so together the tests are worth 80% of your grade. 10% easy online quizzes then 10% participation. Not the hardest class, but hard to get an A and must really work hard to pass.
